analysis: The trial succeeded operationally and achieved host macro validation HR@10 of 0.5575: Movies_and_TV 0.6050, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.5750, Electronics 0.4500, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.6000. Relative to the supplied prior results, consistency improved over the two-view baseline (0.5463) by 0.0112, but remained below bidirectional reconstruction (0.5800) by 0.0225 and the local-convolution variant (0.5725) by 0.0150. This provides limited support for aligning the two views, but does not establish the cause of the remaining gap. Electronics had the lowest category HR@10. No hidden-test performance was reported.
code_summary: One independently trained MaskedSASRec checkpoint per category, with shared parameters across clean and corrupted training views. The network uses 96-dimensional item and position embeddings, two bidirectional Transformer blocks with two attention heads, dropout 0.2, and a Linear–GELU–LayerNorm output head. Scores use tied item embeddings plus jointly trained item biases. Training retains clean final-target prediction and historical masked reconstruction with 256 shared sampled negatives, adding 0.1 × T² KL(clean detached || corrupted) at T=2 for examples containing historical masks. AdamW, seed 42, validation checkpoint selection, stopping rules, and dataset routing are preserved. The exported predictor strictly loads one selected checkpoint per category; the code includes score-parity assertions against that checkpoint.
